Name: TPI Rendezvous
checklistText:
TERMINAL PHASE INITIATION & RENDEZVOUS
Note:
Requires Computer Fidelity: Advanced.
This checklist is for the advanced TPI and Trigger Angle Rendezvous and is under development.

NOMINAL (TERMINAL PHASE INITIATION)

	INITIATION CUE - ANGLE/MDU OUTPUT

	REQUEST TPI PLAN

0:00	APPLY CIRCULARIZAIONT TRANS (IF REQ)
	START GET
	AT 0,0,0 ATT, APPLY THRUST TO
	ZERO READOUTS FROM ADD 80,81,82
	GO TO RDR ACQ ATT, ACQUIRE LOCK-ON
	FDR - RDR
	FDM - ATT

	ATT CNTL - PULSE
	MAN CONT - OFF

	SET E.T. TO 4:00
	BORESIGHT ON AGENA BY
	NULLING FDI'S

4:00	ON MARK (START RNDZ - 5 MINUTES) START E.T UP
	COMPUTER - RNDZ

		NOTE
	READ θ(96) AND R(69)
	(EACH 100 SEC PT)

	INPUT WT = 83:13000
	ΔWT = 93:04820

	NOTE θ WHICH EXCEEDS 20.1° AND
	CIRCLE IT. IF CIRCLED θ IS
	NEARER 20.1° THAN 21.4°, LABEL IT
	PT A. IF NOT, LABEL IT PT B AND
	THE PREVIOUS ONE PT A. ADD 3:20
	TO PT A TIME TO OBTAIN TIME OF 
	PT C. CIRCULATE GET RESET TIME
	BY ADDING 4:30 TO PT C TIME.

	3:20 AFTER PT A (PT C), READ θ(96)
	AND R(69)
	AFTER PT C, START COMP - PUSH
	CALCULATE ΔR AND Δθ CORR

	ATT CNTL - RATE CMD
	MAN CONT - ON

	COMP LITE ON NOMINALLY 03:50
	AFTER PT C, THEN
	START THRUST
	TO ZERO IVI
	(S/C BORESIGHT ON AGENA)

HOW TO FILL OUT TERMINAL PHASE INITIATION FORM








<image>








TERMINAL PHASE INITIATION - NOMINAL

PREPARE FOR RENDEZVOUS
    ACQUIRE RADAR LOCK-ON

    BORESIGHT TARGET
        Maintain target near center of sight.

    COMPUTER - RNDZ
    START - PRESS
        Starts RNDZ program.

    CORE 83 (W_TPR) - 130.00°
    CORE 93 (ΔW_T)  - 48.20°


MONITOR RADAR DATA
    At each 100-second radar data point:

        READ AND RECORD:
            θ       CORE 96     Target elevation
            R       CORE 69     Range
            R DOT   CORE 35     Range rate

        Retain the previous data point.

IDENTIFY POINT B
    MONITOR θ (96) UNTIL θ EXCEEDS 21.4°

    When θ first exceeds 21.4°:
        IF θ < 22.2°:
            LABEL CURRENT DATA POINT - B

        IF θ >= 22.2°:
            LABEL PREVIOUS DATA POINT - B
            LABEL CURRENT DATA POINT  - C

    RECORD POINT B:
        DET TIME
        θ (96)
        R (69)
        R DOT (35)

POINT C
    POINT C - 01:40 AFTER POINT B

    RECORD:
        DET TIME
        θ (96)
        R (69)
        R DOT (35)

    AFTER POINT C:
        START COMP - PRESS

        Closed-loop TPI solution is selected.
        TPI ΔV and maneuver guidance will be displayed.

POINT D
    POINT D - 01:40 AFTER POINT C

    RECORD:
        DET TIME
        θ (96)
        R (69)
        R DOT (35)

    Point D completes the data required
    for the backup TPI solution.

CALCULATE TPI TIME
    TPI ("I") = POINT D TIME + 02:10
    RECORD "I" TIME

CALCULATE DET RESET TIME
    SET = TPI TIME + 00:40
    RECORD "SET" TIME

BACKUP TPI SOLUTION
    Using recorded B, C and D data:
        ENTER TERMINAL PHASE INITIATION CHART

        DETERMINE:
            Range-rate correction
            Normal ΔV correction
            TPI timing correction

        COMPARE BACKUP SOLUTION WITH:
            OBC solution
            Ground solution

TERMINAL PHASE INITIATION
    AT TPI ("I"):

        BORESIGHT TARGET
        VERIFY COMP LIGHT - ON
        APPLY THRUST

        THRUST TO ZERO:
            IVI X
            IVI Y
            IVI Z

POST-TPI TIMING
    AT CALCULATED "SET" TIME:
        RESTART DET TIMING REFERENCE

    AFTER TPI THRUST:
        MAN CONT - OFF
        ATT CNTL - PULSE

        DET - SET 02:00
        DET - STBY

    AT MARK (P):
        DET - START UP

    PROCEED TO 82° CORRECTION



APPENDIX
RNDZ PROGRAM FLOW (CLOSED-LOOP RENDEZVOUS)
Acquire and maintain radar lock.
Computer collects radar observations at 100-sec intervals for 700 sec.

INITIAL SOLUTION
ΔVT displayed 50 sec.
IVIs zero for 50 sec.
At nominal T_M (C POINT), press START to accept solution.
If not accepted, computer obtains another radar observation and updates solution. Record POINT

TPI / ΔVi
At START COMP illumination, thrust to drive IVIs to zero.

T_M +150
Target-pointing attitude available.

T_M +200 to +320
Maintain radar lock.
Seven radar observations at 20-sec intervals.

T_M +320
FDI guidance zero. Perform platform alignment.

VERNIER −80 SEC
Terminate platform alignment.
Realign and maintain target in boresight.

VERNIER
Computer takes final radar observation and calculates correction.
When correction appears on IVIs, thrust to zero.
Repeat vernier procedure as required.

FINAL VERNIER +150 SEC
Closed-loop rendezvous complete.

Proceed with terminal rendezvous.
3000 FT
Initiate braking.
1500 FT
Target approximately 4 ft/sec closing rate.
Continue final approach and null relative motion for station keeping.
